droopboop-flconsole-upwork-mcp-feed-tune.description: Keep the user's Upwork job alerts accurate with the flconsole MCP server. Sets up a feed tuner once (target jobs a day, what the user never takes, budget and client limits), then on an hourly schedule checks each feed with Telegram alerts — the jobs against the user's wishes, how many arrive, what the AI filter skipped, the user's 👍/👎 — and makes at most one set of related edits per run. Every change reaches the user in Telegram with an Undo button. Use when the user wants their job alerts tuned or kept accurate automatically, or when a scheduled task says "Run flconsole feed tuner check".

droopboop-flconsole-upwork-mcp-upwork-jo.description: Find new Upwork jobs that fit the freelancer with the flconsole MCP server. Loads the user's saved context from the server, guides a 3-step setup (search query, job and client filters, the user's own AI filter that you apply), saves it as a feed on the server, checks new jobs, shortlists them with reasons, drafts proposals, tunes the search with job counts and turns on Telegram alerts for a feed in one call. Use when the user wants to find or monitor Upwork jobs, set up or improve a job search, check new jobs, get fewer or more relevant jobs, or decide which jobs to apply to.
